definitions.explanation: A painting technique using oil-based pigments, or a work of art created using this technique. Refers to both the method and the finished work.

examples.japanese: {油彩|ゆさい}で{風景|ふうけい}を{描|えが}く。
examples.english: To paint a landscape in oils.

examples.japanese: この{美術館|びじゅつかん}には{油彩|ゆさい}の{名作|めいさく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This art museum has many masterpieces in oil painting.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{水彩|すいさい}よりも{油彩|ゆさい}のほうが{得意|とくい}だと{言|い}っていた。
examples.english: She said she's better at oil painting than watercolor.

notes:
A compound of {油|あぶら} (oil) and {彩|さい} (coloring, painting). Often contrasted with {水彩|すいさい} (watercolor). The longer form {油彩画|ゆさいが} specifically refers to an oil painting as a finished work, while {油彩|ゆさい} can refer to either the technique or the work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {油彩画|ゆさいが} — oil painting (the artwork)
- {油彩|ゆさい}で{描|えが}く — to paint in oils
- {油彩|ゆさい}{技法|ぎほう} — oil painting technique
- {油彩|ゆさい}{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} — oil paint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {油絵|あぶらえ} — oil painting; the everyday word, more common in casual conversation
- {水彩|すいさい} — watercolor; painting with water-soluble pigments
- {日本画|にほんが} — Japanese-style painting; traditional painting using mineral pigments and sumi ink
